The viscera involved is the colon, and its sympathetic supply originates from preganglionic neurons in the intermediolateral cell column of the spinal cord at roughly T10–L2. These fibers travel through the thoracic and lumbar splanchnic nerves and synapse in the superior and inferior mesenteric ganglia. The team note's T7–L2 range is broader than the colon's segmental supply, so I'd keep T10–L2 unless a source says otherwise.

CONFIDENCE: 70
